last_result.headline: Q46 resolved every provenance field for all seven candidates to KNOWN, using the submission object's url field which carries kernel slug AND scriptVersionId directly. Five submission outputs are archived in reports/submission_outputs/ and each is verified against a number recorded at submission time (rmse 1.640, 1.756, 3.105/2.537, sha256 b192d3). THE FINDING: the three teammate kernels scored 6.563/6.669/6.678 yet now return BYTE-IDENTICAL output, so at least two have been re-run since submission -- direct evidence for the question Q38 left open. The submitted artifact of the score-first slot-1 candidate 54922806 is therefore not archived and cannot be fetched by API; it is one owner UI action away (scriptVersionId 337355891 -> Output). The recommendation is unchanged, but the asymmetry is clean: choosing 54968060 for slot 1 leaves every asset already archived and verified, choosing 54922806 leaves one owner action outstanding.
